negative_reviews.author: hafeez gorji
negative_reviews.text: Food was substandard for the price and what i expected, based on the good reviews of this place. The ramen I had was okay at best. Broth was pretty tasteless, chicken was literally just boiled with no flavour and there just lacked any real flavour to the dish. Helped somewhat with chilli oil which the server kindly provided. Service cant be faulted in all honesty. Wont return unfortunately.

issues: Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Delivery performance was poor across the region, with high rider waiting times, missing items and insufficient photographic evidence attached to claims.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The new loyalty system is letting customers stack multiple vouchers on a single tab, and several sites reported display and redemption problems.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Takeaway packaging from China has still not arrived and sites are waiting on it for delivery presentation.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Event food spend continues to sit within site food cost, but the food cost budget will be increased for sites running B2B events.
Covers increased week on week but spend per head was low and sales finished below target, with weekends unusually quiet.
Delivery prep times increased and completed orders fell, with no cause identified yet by the site.

Labour cost came in well above the budgeted rate despite only a small number of extra hours being used, suggesting either an error in the labour percentage calculation or inaccurate break and hours logging in the rota tool.
Food cost improved on the previous week but remains over target, with orders needing approval before being placed.
A negative Google review on flavour was received, judged to be personal taste after a recipe and quality check.
Review volume remains low and has been added as an area of improvement.
Two competitor sites are opening next door and are already performing strongly on social media, which is expected to affect trade.
